name: qmstrace
description: Keeps the state, traceability and audit evidence of a software project's work products under ISO/IEC 29110.

paragraphs: The trace layer under a quality-management system. qmstrace keeps the state, traceability and audit evidence of a software project's work products, so that an auditor's questions are answered by query instead of by assembly. ISO/IEC 29110 is the first standard it knows; the standard is data, not code.

It is a command-line tool installed into repositories that already exist. It holds no project data and owns no evidence: it reads markers where people and coding agents already write — a requirement's heading, a line under a design section, a tag on a test — judges them, and points at evidence that stays in its home system.

Status. Setup, trace queries, coverage checks, the project-wide check run in the ledger, baseline and change guards, suspects and the offline browser work locally, for Python (pytest) and C# (xUnit) repos, with JUnit and TRX results. Pinned imports and signatures are not built yet. See the tracker.
